title: thalictrum bauhini subsp. tenuifolium
intro: Thalictrum bauhini subsp. tenuifolium, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a plant species belonging to the family Ranunculaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Rue include its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit antiviral and antibacterial properties, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Thalictrum bauhini subsp. tenuifolium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
